senses.gloss: f. (= אוֹנָאָה; ינה) oppression, wrong. Sifra B’har ch. III, Par. 3 הניית ממון … הניית דברים, read הוֹנָיַית.—Esp. (law) imposition, fraudulent representation; redress in case of overreaching, v. אוֹנָאָה.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 4:6">B. Mets. IV, 6</cite> Y. ed. (Mish. ib. IV, 7 <cite ref="A01338"><he>או׳</he></cite>) <he>ההינייה וכ׳</he> the overreaching, to be actionable, must be at least four M’ah &c. Y. Keth. XI, 34ᶜ top <he>אין למקח ה׳ וכ׳</he> against purchase there is no claim for overreaching, i.e. the purchase itself is not invalidated.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 4:3:2">Y. B. Mets. IV, 9ᵈ</cite> top <he>ה׳ עצמה</he> the actual amount overcharged.

<cite ref="Yoma 2a:8">Ib.</cite> <he>הוֹנָיָיתוֹ</he> the amount with which he was overcharged. Sifra l. c. <he>יש ה׳</he> legal redress can be claimed; a. v. fr.—Pl. <he>הוֹנָיוֹת</he>, v. <cite ref="A00740"><he>אוֹנָיָה</he></cite>.
